ideas.children_he: הָאֲנָשִׁים דִּבְּרוּ בְּשָׂפָה אַחַת וּבָנוּ מִגְדָּל גָּדוֹל. כְּשֶׁמְּשַׁתְּפִים פְּעֻלָּה אֶפְשָׁר לַעֲשׂוֹת דְּבָרִים גְּדוֹלִים, אֲבָל חָשׁוּב לִבְחֹר מַטָּרָה טוֹבָה.
ideas.children_en: At first, all people spoke one language and knew each other. They came from the east and settled in a place called Shinar. They built houses from bricks and clay and made a tower to have a center everyone could see and meet at.

ideas.children_he: הָאַחְדוּת נָתְנָה לָאֲנָשִׁים כֹּחַ רַב. כֹּחַ מְשֻׁתָּף יָכוֹל לַעֲזֹר, אֲבָל הוּא יָכוֹל גַּם לְהַזִּיק אִם אֵין לוֹ גְּבוּלוֹת.
ideas.children_en: God saw that people were united in whatever they did. Being one and speaking one language made them strong. But since people can have bad in their hearts, such unity might let bad grow without limits.

ideas.children_he: כְּשֶׁהַשָּׂפוֹת הִתְבַּלְבְּלוּ, הָאֲנָשִׁים לֹא הֵבִינוּ זֶה אֶת זֶה. הַסִּפּוּר מַזְכִּיר שֶׁהַקְשָׁבָה וַהֲבָנָה חֲשׁוּבוֹת לְשִׁתּוּף פְּעֻלָּה.
ideas.children_en: To stop this unity, God made them not understand each other and mixed their languages. Because they couldn't speak together, they split up and spread all over the world, and people became different.

ideas.children_he: הַתּוֹרָה מְסַפֶּרֶת עַל מִשְׁפַּחְתּוֹ שֶׁל שֵׁם אַחֲרֵי הַמַּבּוּל. כָּל מִשְׁפָּחָה הִיא חֵלֶק מִשַּׁרְשֶׁרֶת דּוֹרוֹת.
ideas.children_en: Shem was 100 years old when Arpachshad was born after the flood. He lived many more years and had many children. This tells the story of Shem's family after the flood.

ideas.children_he: דּוֹרוֹת רַבִּים עָבְרוּ מִפֶּלֶג וְעַד תֶּרַח. כָּל אָדָם מְקַבֵּל מַשֶּׁהוּ מֵהַדּוֹר שֶׁלְּפָנָיו.
ideas.children_en: Peleg was 30 when Reu was born. They all lived long and had many children. This is the family line that leads to Terach, telling about the family through the generations.

ideas.children_he: לְתֶרַח נוֹלְדוּ אַבְרָם, נָחוֹר וְהָרָן. הַמִּשְׁפָּחָה הַזֹּאת תִּהְיֶה חֲשׁוּבָה מְאֹד בְּהֶמְשֵׁךְ הַסִּפּוּר.
ideas.children_en: Terach lived seventy years before he had Abram, Nahor and Haran. They are an important family for the rest of the Bible story.

ideas.children_he: הָרָן מֵת עוֹד בְּחַיֵּי אָבִיו. לִפְעָמִים מִשְׁפָּחוֹת עוֹבְרוֹת אֲבֵדָה כּוֹאֶבֶת, וְהֵן זְקוּקוֹת לְתְמִיכָה.
ideas.children_en: Haran, one of Terach's sons, died while his father was still alive in their homeland, Ur Kaśdim. It was unusual for a son to die before his father.

ideas.children_he: אַבְרָם וְשָׂרַי הָיוּ נְשׂוּאִים, אֲבָל לֹא הָיוּ לָהֶם יְלָדִים. לְכָל מִשְׁפָּחָה יֵשׁ קְשָׁיִים וְתִקְווֹת מִשֶּׁלָּהּ.
ideas.children_en: Abram and Nahor married women. Abram's wife Sarai could not have children, but Nahor's wife Milcah had many children and a long family line.

ideas.children_he: תֶּרַח וּמִשְׁפַּחְתּוֹ יָצְאוּ לְדֶרֶךְ חֲדָשָׁה וְעָצְרוּ בְּחָרָן. לִפְעָמִים הַדֶּרֶךְ לַמָּקוֹם הַחָדָשׁ אֲרוּכָּה מִמַּה שֶּׁחָשַׁבְנוּ.
ideas.children_en: Terach took Abram, Lot and Sarai on a journey from their home to a new land called Canaan. They stopped in Haran and stayed there for a while.

ideas.children_he: תֶּרַח מֵת בְּחָרָן, וְהַסִּפּוּר עוֹבֵר לְאַבְרָם. כְּשֶׁפֶּרֶק אֶחָד מִסְתַּיֵּם, פֶּרֶק חָדָשׁ יָכוֹל לְהַתְחִיל.
ideas.children_en: Terach died in Haran at age 205. After that, the story focuses on Abram, an important generation for the rest of Genesis.
